question: Abzan Advantage makes a player sacrifice an enchantment, and then I bolster 1. Is that enchantment already off the battlefield by the time I bolster?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the enchantment has already left the battlefield when you bolster 1.
expected.answer: The enchantment will have already left the battlefield when you bolster 1.
